card.name: Linking words before age or weight limits
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', 'not' or 'is', or a space after 'less than' or 'under', placed just before an age, weight or patient-group restriction in dosing text.

modes.label: 'and' joining criteria
modes.description: The word 'and' links two patient criteria, such as weight and age, in pediatric dosing.
modes.example: § Pediatric patients < 50 kg<< and>> ≥ 6 months of age 8

modes.label: Space after 'less than'/'under'
modes.description: The blank space after 'less than' or 'under' comes just before a numeric age or renal cutoff.
modes.example: Patients less than<< >>2 years of age may require up to

modes.label: 'not' or 'is' before 'recommended'
modes.description: A negation or verb comes right before a statement that use is not recommended in a group.
modes.example: Fesoterodine fumarate extended-release tablets are<< not>> recommended in patients with clinically significant bladder outlet

card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before an age, weight or population limit in a dosing instruction.
